summary: One-frame result of reporting a mod (UGC report) on the client. Written by bg3.exe+0x1B23370, which handles a pending mod report (the report is also kept on disk as '<id>.lsx' and removed); registered by ecl::mod::PendingModReportsSystem (bg3.exe+0x755930) together with ecl::mod::PendingReportsSingletonComponent and ls::ugc::ReportModResultOneFrameComponent. Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (client row).

fields.name: ModId
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1B24260 (AllocRaw 0x10) zeroes the qword at +0. Writer bg3.exe+0x1B23370 stores `*(ulonglong*)p = uVar4`, the 64-bit key it removed from the pending-reports table (compared with `*(ulonglong*)(param_3[4] + i*8)`) and formatted into the report's file name '<id>.lsx' (FUN_14057e730 with the number). macOS PendingModReportsSystemHelper::SendReport(unsigned long long, net::EUGReportReason, ...) takes the mod id as unsigned long long.

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes the uint16 at +8. bg3.exe+0x1B23370 writes `*(bool*)(p+8) = (char)*plVar25 == 0` (a flag of the pending entry, local_280) - probably success/accepted; then only when it is set does it call the report back-end.

fields.name: field_9
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1B23370 writes 0 to +9, then (retry count < 10) the byte returned by virtual slot +0x20 of the UGC back-end object; else it calls slot +0x18 with the string. Probably a bool result.

fields.name: _Pad10
fields.evidence: padding to the registry size 16 (8-byte alignment of ModId).

open_questions: Meaning of the flags at +8 and +9 (success / sent?) not established; offsets and widths are.
